annotations.title: Get an icon as a favicon SVG

description: Return one library icon as a favicon-ready SVG with a fixed color (favicons cannot inherit currentColor) and an optional dark-mode color. Get ids from search_icons.

dark_color.description: Icon color in dark mode (prefers-color-scheme: dark). Default: same as color.

stroke_width.description: Stroke width for outline icons on a 24-unit grid. Default 2.2.

name: get_icon_svg
title: Get an icon as a favicon SVG
